error.wrong_account: You signed in as @{login}, but this workspace belongs to another account.
git.missing.title: Git is not installed
git.missing.description: Workspaces made now are plain files on this computer: no history, no audit log, no way to revert a change, and no sync. Install Git, then check again, to get them.
login.enter_code: Enter this code on GitHub to sign in:
account.heading: GitHub account
account.help_team: The workspace syncs as this account, with the access the account was given. Someone else's workspace has to be given to this account in the Bifurc Console before it can be imported.
account.help_owner: The workspace syncs as this account. Only the account that owns a workspace can use it.
account.help_optional: Optional. Only needed to sync this workspace with a remote repository; it can be added later.
account.not_set_up: GitHub sign-in is not set up in this build, so workspaces stay on this computer.
sign_in.title: Sign in to GitHub
repos.heading: Repository
repos.sign_in_first: Sign in to choose one of your repositories.
repos.empty_team: This account has no repositories yet, of its own or shared with it.
repos.empty_owner: This account owns no repositories yet.
repos.read_only_note: Your account has read access to this repository, so the workspace will be read-only here: you get what the repository gets, and what you change stays on this device.
publish.name_help: A new repository is created on the account. An existing one is never pushed into, and the repository can't be changed afterwards.
publish.sync_all: Also sync everything that was never synced, one commit per item
name.label: Name
